positions.title: Senior Technical Writer
positions.description: As part of a docs team, I used a docs-as-code approach to contribute to the Netlify docs (https://docs.netlify.com/). I used the same tools that developers do so that I could be closer to their work and they could more easily contribute to mine.\n\nWhen I started at Netlify, I covered the core build system and integrations, like build plugins. Later, I documented Netlify's ecosystem integrations. This means I spent a lot of time in the wider web development community and figuring out how various tools and frameworks do their magic on Netlify.

positions.title: Senior Technical Writer/Web Developer
positions.description:
I stepped down as Scrum Master so that I could focus on building a new web platform for the team's documentation.

The platform is made up of two primary pieces:
• A publishing process that transforms Author-it XML into HTML and JSON output.
• A single-page web application built with Vue that consumes the transformed output.

This development work is in addition to my regular documentation responsibilities.

positions.title: Technical Writer/Scrum Master
positions.description: In addition to my technical writer duties, I serve as Scrum Master for one of the two Scrum teams in the Documentation Department. In this role, I enable others to do their jobs more effectively.

positions.title: Editor III (Consultant)
positions.description:
As part of the HR User Experience team, I gathered, curated, wrote, and edited content for a complete site overhaul.

Primary goals of the project were to simplify the user experience and bring the "human" aspect into eBay's Human Resources content.

I coordinated with dozens of HR SMEs to revamp their content. I also worked with designers and technical experts to ensure that the new content satisfied HR SMEs.

positions.title: Technical Writer
positions.description:
My work at Emsi was multi-faceted and crossed several disciplines.

Blog Content
• Create content for many audiences, primarily higher education institutions
• Write various content types including case studies, data analysis, and product announcements
• Conduct SEO research to ensure the content is easy to find and drives traffic
• Collaborate with design and video team members to create exciting content

Research & Data Analysis
• Research primary audiences and their markets
• Collect data and identify key trends that audiences find valuable
• Analyze large amounts of data for media (newspapers, etc.) requests
• Create graphs and charts using Plot.ly and Tableau

Content Marketing
• Increase conversion rates by employing inbound content marketing concepts
• Align content with needs of clients and sales team
• Contribute to and maintain company voice and brand
• Manage social media channels, engaging audiences through interesting posts

Technical Work
• Understand and employ Emsi's complex software products to inform content creation
• Create, edit, and maintain RFPs and RFP templates

positions.title: Electronics Writer
positions.description:
Even though my title at Top Ten Reviews was Writer, my day-to-day tasks involved project management, research, and much more. I often switched gears quickly to meet deadlines.

Project Management
• Evaluate current markets in a given category and request products for review
• Follow-up with submissions team to ensure I receive products before they are needed
• Schedule time for research, writing, editing and publication
• Work with Managing and Copy Editors to get ahead of projects before they start
• Follow-up with web producers and graphics designers to ensure timeliness
• Meet with stakeholders from other departments to ensure my project satisfies demands

Research
• Evaluate a given audience with tools such as the Adobe Marketing Cloud
• Seek out new trends in a given area to identify innovations in technology
• Identify top brands in a given area and find what sets them apart from the marketplace

Hardware Benchmarking
• Develop hardware testing strategies to evaluate a developer's claims of efficacy
• Compare manufacturer specifications with a product's functionality
• Accumulate quantifiable datasets that allow for an apples-to-apples comparisons

Graphic Design
• Have a keen eye for presenting hardware appropriately
• Apply Adobe Photoshop to properly frame images

Writing
• Curate 20 websites, each of which I optimize for SEO and audiences
• Generate over 6,100 words across 11 pages of research-based content for each site
• Write captions for over 56 images taken during testing on each site
• Create engaging content that both satisfies Google search parameters and the readers curiosity
